text:
maria (PM): quick sync — we need to lock the design partner (DP) pilot commitment terms for the small micro-cohort launching first week of apr. main open items: credits, data handling checkbox, eval cadence, and what counts as 'success'.
kevin (Eng): ok. can we make the credit allocation tied to usage bands? e.g. 50k tokens/mo free, then overage discounts. keeps support predictable.
anya (Product): +1 to bands. also want an explicit rollback path if perf/regression happens (canary rollback to hosted variant).
sam (SWE): for rollback we need an API flag to opt into auto-fallback. timeline to ship that? ~1 week scoped change.
maria (PM): sounds fine. jules (Legal): we need plain-language clause for PII + a customer confirmation checkbox during onboarding. sample wording: ‘I agree that my data may be processed for inference and diagnostics; no content will be used to further train models without consent.’
jules (Legal): also require retention window (30 days) and exportability of logs on request.
anya (Product): i'll add a short consent checkbox UI copy. ops-bot: https://redwood-internal/sheets/DP-pilot-terms — i've sketched credit bands + metric definitions there.
kevin (Eng): putting metric hooks into runtime: suggest these KPIs: success_rate (calls w/ no fallback), 95th_latency_ms, tokens_per_request_avg, cost_per_1k_tokens. ops-bot: added metric IDs.
maria (PM): critical: define success criteria for pilot signoff. proposal: 1) avg 95th latency plateau < 600ms under expected load, 2) quality regression <= 3% on our eval set, 3) adoption: at least 5 active seats integrated and 10k monthly tokens usage. thoughts?
sam (SWE): quality regression threshold needs measurement plan. i'll pair with anya to define the eval prompt set and scoring script.
anya (Product): i'll assemble ~40 prompts (mix of user flows + edge cases) and a small rubric. we should automate eval runs daily during pilot.
jules (Legal): add a clause for data incidents and escalation SLA (24h initial ack, 72h remediation plan).
maria (PM): onboarding checklist I want in the sheet: 1) NDA signed, 2) credits assigned, 3) consent checkbox enabled, 4) eval set uploaded, 5) engineering triage contact assigned.
kevin (Eng): assign eng contact: sam. ops-bot: created eng contact role in the invite flow.
anya (Product): draft acceptance email (short) — paste for review: ```Hi <PartnerName>, thanks for joining our micro-pilot. Please confirm: 1) NDA signed, 2) consent checkbox accepted, 3) onboarding slot (choose here: <cal link>). We'll provision credits and send integration docs within 48h. — Anya```
jules (Legal): minor edit: replace 'consent checkbox accepted' with 'data processing consent granted'.
maria (PM): can we include a short FAQ in the onboarding packet about rollback and expected degradation? partners often ask.
sam (SWE): i'll draft FAQ entries on rollback, metrics, and how to opt out. also include sample API header to enable 'pilot=true' and 'autofallback=on'. code snippet: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -H "X-Redwood-Pilot: true" -d '{"input":"..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate```
anya (Product): timeline check — recruiting cutoff: mar 31. onboarding start apr 6. can we get legal signoff on the clause by mar 25?
jules (Legal): yes, i'll circulate a short clause today and +1 if no issues by 25th.
maria (PM): great. action items: anya — finalize acceptance email and eval set (due 3/28); sam — implement pilot flag + metric hooks (due 4/1); jules — finalize consent + SLA clause (due 3/25). i'll own the recruitment outreach and spreadsheet updates.
kevin (Eng): noted. anything else?
anya (Product): one ask from ops: include a 'priority support' token for DP partners to escalate infra issues. simple label in support portal.
ops-bot: support label 'dp-priority' created.
maria (PM): perfect. thanks team — i'll follow up with candidate list tomorrow and start outreach. :rocket:
